attempts.cause: The fiscal_calendar.quarter_of function incorrectly calculates the quarter for months July through September (Q1) and October through December (Q2) when the fiscal year starts in July.
attempts.candidate:
create or replace package body fiscal_calendar as
  function year_of(p_date in date) return number is
  begin
    return extract(year from p_date) + case when extract(month from p_date) >= 7 then 1 else 0 end;
  end year_of;

  function quarter_of(p_date in date) return number is
  begin
    -- Fiscal year starts in July (Month 7).
    -- Q1: Jul, Aug, Sep (Months 7, 8, 9) -> Quarter 1
    -- Q2: Oct, Nov, Dec (Months 10, 11, 12) -> Quarter 2
    -- Q3: Jan, Feb, Mar (Months 1, 2, 3) -> Quarter 3
    -- Q4: Apr, May, Jun (Months 4, 5, 6) -> Quarter 4
    
    -- Adjust month to be 1-based relative to the fiscal year start (July=1, Aug=2, ..., Jun=12)
    -- If month >= 7, it's in the first 6 months of the fiscal year (July to Dec).
    -- If month < 7, it's in the last 6 months of the fiscal year (Jan to Jun).
    
    -- Calculate month offset from July (Month 7)
    DECLARE
        v_month_offset NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        IF extract(month from p_date) >= 7 THEN
            -- Months 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 map to fiscal months 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
            v_month_offset := extract(month from p_date) - 6; -- 7->1, 8->2, ..., 12->6
        ELSE
            -- Months 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 map to fiscal months 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12
            v_month_offset := extract(month from p_date) + 6; -- 1->7, 2->8, ..., 6->12
        END IF;
        
        -- Quarter is calculated based on fiscal month (1-12)
        return CEIL(v_month_offset / 3);
    END;
  end quarter_of;
end fiscal_calendar;
/
